extension.description:
Tubi TV has the largest library of FREE videos of hit and cult TV shows and films.
* Browse the Tubi categories, series and films * Home, My List and Continue Watching from your account * Live TV, with IPTV Manager integration for the Kodi TV guide * Search the Tubi catalogue * Add films and shows to the Kodi library as .strm files * Optional Tubi account sign-in * PseudoTV Live support
extension.disclaimer: Feel free to use this script. For information visit the wiki.
extension.news:
2026.8.11.12 - Ask Tubi for the stream its own player uses - FIXED: Some titles have no unencrypted hlsv6 at all - their only clear rendition is an hlsv3 480p beside encrypted 720p ones, and the addon never asked Tubi for hlsv3. On those titles the only thing left to pick was a 720p rendition demanding HDCP, which a software CDM cannot play. Tubi's own web player takes the hlsv3 on exactly these titles and never requests a licence; the addon now asks for it too. - NEW: Playback logs what Tubi offered and which rendition was taken, with its resolution, codec and HDCP grade. Which one is chosen is the whole of what "Allow HDCP protected streams" decides, and whether an hlsv3 came back is not visible anywhere else.
2026.8.11.11 - Home was only its first seven rows - FIXED: Home listed seven rows where Tubi's own home screen has forty or more. Tubi serves its home in two calls - the first seven rows, then every row after them - and the addon only ever made the first, so the personalised rows past Watch Next were never shown.
2026.8.11.10 - Menu tidy, and a log worth reading - CHANGED: My List has gone the way of Continue Watching - Home carries a row for it already. The menu is one call again. - CHANGED: The addon logged almost everything at debug level, so a normal Kodi log said nothing even when a call had failed. Failures, sign-in and sign-out, and anything that changes the account now log at a level an ordinary log shows.
2026.8.11.9 - No Continue Watching twice - CHANGED: Home is Tubi's own screen and already carries a Continue Watching row, so the separate menu entry for it is gone. One fewer call on opening the addon as well.
2026.8.11.8 - No empty rows in the menu - CHANGED: Continue Watching and My List appear only when they have something in them, and never when signed out, where neither can. Both lists are read alongside the categories rather than after them, so the menu is no slower for knowing.
2026.8.11.7 - Sign out properly - CHANGED: "Clear saved session" is now "Sign out", and tells Tubi rather than only forgetting the tokens locally, so the device stops being signed in on Tubi's side too. It still clears locally if Tubi cannot be reached.
2026.8.11.6 - Continue Watching, both ways - NEW: "Remove from Continue Watching" on any title Tubi is tracking. - NEW: Films and episodes carry the position Tubi has for them, so Kodi offers to resume where you stopped - on any device, not just this one.
2026.8.11.5 - The service says what it did - CHANGED: Progress reporting logged only at debug level, so with normal logging there was no way to tell whether it had run. It now reports at info level, says when it skipped a title as barely watched, and logs once at startup so the service can be seen running at all.
2026.8.11.4 - My List shows the action that applies - FIXED: A title already on My List still offered "Add to My List" everywhere except inside the list itself. The entry now reads Add or Remove according to whether the title is actually on the list.
2026.8.11.3 - Episodes report their progress too - NEW: Episodes now report where you stopped, not just films. An episode goes across as itself with its series named alongside, which is what Tubi's history wants and what was missing before.
2026.8.11.2 - My List, ratings and language - NEW: Add to and remove from My List, from the context menu on any title. - NEW: Like and dislike, which toggle back off when pressed again. - NEW: Language - Tubi serves its categories and descriptions in English, Spanish or French depending on what it is asked for.
2026.8.11.1 - Home, My List, Continue Watching - NEW: Home lists Tubi's own personalised rows. - NEW: My List and Continue Watching, both taken from the account. - NEW: "Related titles" and "Play trailer" on every film and series. - NEW: Kids mode. - NEW: Films report where you stopped, so Tubi's own apps and Continue Watching agree. Off-limits for episodes until Tubi's history is seen accepting one; only a film has ever been captured.
2026.8.11 - Modern list items - FIXED: Every list item logged two deprecation warnings, because t1mlib still builds them with ListItem.setInfo() and addStreamInfo(). The addon now fills the video info tag through its own setters on Kodi 20 and later, falling back to the old calls on Kodi 19 which has nothing else.
2026.8.10.8 - Guide text - FIXED: Some guide titles and descriptions arrived HTML-escaped and were passed on as-is, so Kodi displayed "Amos & Andrew" and "café" literally. Entities are now resolved to the characters they stand for.
2026.8.10.7 - Faster live guide - CHANGED: The guide's batches are now fetched a few at a time instead of one after another, cutting a refresh from tens of seconds to a few. The tools that ask for it are waiting on a socket while it is built. - NEW: The addon logs how many channels and programmes it handed over and how long it took, so an empty guide can be told apart from one that was never asked for.
2026.8.10.6 - Live guide fix - FIXED: The channels reached the Kodi TV guide but the programme schedule never did. IPTV Manager allows ten seconds for the addon to call back, and the addon was building the whole guide - one request per batch of channels - before opening the connection. It now connects first and builds afterwards, which is what IPTV Manager waits for. - FIXED: One failed batch no longer discards the entire guide.
2026.8.10.5 - Live TV - NEW: Tubi's 177 linear channels, with a Live TV folder in the addon and IPTV Manager integration so they appear in the Kodi TV guide with a full programme schedule.
2026.8.10.4 - Current DRM properties - CHANGED: On inputstream.adaptive 21 and later the DRM configuration is passed through drm_legacy, which clears the deprecation warning about the license_type and license_key properties. Older builds, which only understand the old properties, keep using them.
2026.8.10.3 - DRM playback fix - FIXED: Encrypted titles failed to decode with "Failed to initialize a DRM session". Tubi grades the same film twice - its 720p renditions demand HDCP and Widevine security level 2, its 576p ones demand neither - and the addon was picking the protected one, which a software CDM cannot satisfy. It now prefers the rendition that plays without HDCP. - NEW: "Allow HDCP protected streams" for devices with hardware DRM that can play the higher quality renditions.
2026.8.10.2 - Search fix - FIXED: Opening Search crashed the addon. The menu entry carried an empty url, Kodi trimmed the '=' off it, and t1mlib could not parse the query back. The entry now carries a value, and default.py repairs a trimmed query before handing it over.
2026.8.10.1 - Moved to Tubi's current API - FIXED: Browsing, search and playback have moved off the retired /oz endpoints and onto the API the Tubi site itself now uses. Nothing in the addon reached a live endpoint before this. - NEW: Categories page properly, series list their seasons, and search returns the full result set. - NEW: Widevine playback through inputstream.adaptive for the titles Tubi encrypts. Titles served in the clear still play without it.
2026.8.10 - Sign-in repaired - FIXED: Signing in no longer uses the retired /oz/auth/login endpoint. The addon now performs the same handshake as the Tubi web client: a signed anonymous device token, then the account login, then the web session handover that yields the cookie the content calls need. - FIXED: The addon no longer dies on startup when the sign-in fails. Tubi is free to browse, so it carries on anonymously and reports the problem. - FIXED: Tokens are cached in the addon profile instead of being fetched on every single browse and playback. - FIXED: Translations are read again (moved to the Kodi 19+ language layout). - NEW: "Clear saved session" in settings for a clean sign-in.
